name: anonymous-object-test-5197ee0f89/anonymous-object-v.bal

spec_references.heading: Expressions
spec_references.explanation: The positive expression list includes new expressions but does not include object-constructor expressions (object { ... }). These are distinct constructs.

spec_references.heading: Object/class definitions
spec_references.explanation: Support for object type descriptors and their members does not add object-constructor expressions to the supported expression list.

reason: Essential anonymous object-constructor expressions are not covered by the supported expression list. The first function passes object { public int k = 14; public string s = "sameera"; } as an argument, and many subsequent tests also require these constructors. This makes the whole case a feature request.
unsupported_constructs: Anonymous object-constructor expressions: object { fields and method definitions }
test_design_notes: Mixed case includes anonymous object type descriptors, classes, initialization methods, structural assignment, records, tuples, field access and method calls; one essential uncovered construct suffices for classification.
io:println and @output comments are output instrumentation; there are no @error markers.
